title: Bytes for Humans
goal: Write human(n): return the size with one decimal and the unit B, KB, MB or GB (1024 per step), like "1.5 GB" or "512.0 B".
hints: Keep a list of units and divide while the number is 1024 or more.

def human(n):
    units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]
    i = 0
    n = float(n)
    while n >= 1024 and i < len(units) - 1:
        n /= 1024
        i += 1
    return f"{n:.1f} {units[i]}"
socratic: When do you switch to the next unit?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
